name: zodiacs-developer
description: Build and verify astrology integrations with the published Zodiacs engine, bounded sky tools and local chart comparison.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.26: Rebuilt with the hosted server's 0.6.3 source, which changes only the version it reports. Its local tools are unchanged. 0.3.25: Rebuilt with the hosted server's 0.6.2 source, whose answers link back to zodiacs.org: get_sky and check_sky_fact link the sky calendar, the horoscopes link the daily email and a reading of two adults links an invitation to compare charts, and compatibility and date share links carry the reading confidence. Share links for the big three, the Chinese zodiac's animal and a month's or year's horoscope, and the readings panel that lists the lunar nodes and Chiron, come only with ZODIACS_SKY_EVENTS_ENABLED=1, which this local server does not set. Its local chart tools are unchanged. 0.3.24: Rebuilt with the hosted server's 0.6.2 source, which adds Chiron to the natal chart, search_sky_events and explain_astrology, offered by the hosted server only with ZODIACS_SKY_EVENTS_ENABLED=1 and not by this local server. Its local tools, and the tools it offers, are unchanged. 0.3.23: Rebuilt with the hosted server's 0.6.2 source, which adds search_sky_events and the natal chart's lunar nodes and Placidus houses, offered by the hosted server only with ZODIACS_SKY_EVENTS_ENABLED=1 and not by this local server. Its local tools, and the tools it offers, are unchanged. 0.3.22: Rebuilt with the hosted server's 0.6.2 source, which changes only the version it reports. Its local tools are unchanged. 0.3.21: Rebuilt with the hosted server's 0.6.1 source: the readings panel for the five coverage tools, the under-18 rule, Sun-sign pair explainers and the narrower links. Its local tools are unchanged. 0.3.20: Rebuilt with the hosted server's reading confidence labels, retrograde pass counts, plain tool text, capabilities for 19 tools, quieter share links and find_birthplace. Its local tools are unchanged. 0.3.19: Rebuilt with the hosted server's 0.6.0 tool fixes: explain_astrology answers the Midheaven, a sign rising, a house written without the word house and a house past the twelfth; get_horoscope_period serves the July to September 2026 monthly readings without dashes and leaves the Moon's sign changes out of a month's sky; get_natal_chart adds timeNote when the clocks skipped or repeated the hour given; get_personal_transits refuses a window before the birth date and lists the slow planets on the personal planets in the year ahead; get_capabilities names every tool offered. Its local tools are unchanged. 0.3.18: Rebuilt with the hosted server's get_horoscope_period description and available years, which now list the published 2026 and 2027 yearly readings; its local tools are unchanged. 0.3.17: Rebuilt with the hosted server's field-named argument errors, plain dates on get_upcoming_events and the JSON-RPC parse error. 0.3.16: Rebuilt with the hosted server's corrected explain_astrology matching and untimed natal chart signs; its local tools are unchanged. 0.3.15: Rebuilt with the hosted server's 0.6.0 source; its local tools, their schemas and the engine are unchanged, and get_local_chart_capabilities reports adapter version 0.6.0. 0.3.14: Its local chart tools are MCP adapter 0.1.0-rc.25's, which bundle engine 1.1.0-rc.1, an unpublished candidate with 1.0.0's values. The records it writes list the ids of the Zodiacs conventions registry that they name, which 1.0.0 refuses, and get_local_chart_capabilities labels the engine an unpublished candidate. Its external recipes still install 1.0.0 from npm. Earlier review archives remain available.

interface.longDescription:
Developed by Zodiacs LLC, the operator of Zodiacs.org. Build Moon widgets, sky calendars and astrology APIs with the published Zodiacs engine. Verify calculation records and test timezones with synthetic inputs. The local developer server supports natal calculations without a listener or outbound connection; the assistant provider can still receive inputs and results. Chart Studio includes placement inspection, house comparison, UTC time exploration and calculation-record inspection. Explore a possible birth-time window without choosing a birth time. Imported records stay in the panel; they can be compared or recalculated with the installed engine. Sharing a selection with the assistant requires a review and explicit action. Public directory availability is not offered by this review candidate.

Official website: https://zodiacs.org/ . Company and contact: https://zodiacs.org/about/ . Support: admin@zodiacs.org . Methods and developer documentation: https://zodiacs.org/developers/ . Privacy and terms are linked in this profile.
